messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot readiness - model shortlist, perf links, prompt pack

Hi Alyssa / Patrick —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick post-call recap and a recommended path forward so your engineering and ML teams can evaluate fit quickly: 

1) Pilot objective (recap):
- Validate document understanding + structured extraction on claims data (multi-document context, ~2–3k tokens typical).
- Maintain P95 latency under 800ms for single-request interactive QA in our dedicated pilot config.

2) Model shortlist (recommended for initial pilot):
- rw-medium-7b-q4_1 (balanced quality/cost) — Redwood-verified TPS: 46 req/s (512-token window), latency p50=220ms / p95=640ms / p99=980ms.
- rw-large-13b-q4_0 (higher LM quality for tricky long-context extraction) — TPS: 18 req/s, latency p50=420ms / p95=780ms / p99=1200ms.
- rw-embed-compact (for vector + rerank steps) — 2,300 embeds/s on standard infer node.

Notes: TPS/latency above measured on a single 80GB A100 equivalent worker with continuous batching; numbers are Redwood-verified for the model + config we ran (seq length 2k warmup). I included the verified profiles and the raw perf CSV in the links/attachments below.

3) Prompt pack + evals:
- Attached: deepfit-prompt-pack-v1.zip — contains 120 prompt templates, 40 eval cases, and prompt engineering notes for edge cases we discussed (multi-doc merges, redaction rules).
- Quick smoke evaluation: we ran the 40-case suite against rw-medium-7b and rw-large-13b; accuracy delta was ~6% favoring the 13b on the extraction F1 metric. Full outputs are in the Drive link.

4) Quality regression guardrails we recommend for pilot:
- Keep a fixed prompt set (the eval pack) for regression checks on each model version.
- Configure automatic rollback on model rollout if F1 drops >4% vs baseline AND p95 latency increases >20%.

5) Next steps / asks (proposed):
- If this aligns, we'll provision a Dedicated pilot (2 workers) for a 2-week run; target start Tues, 10/26.
- Please share an initial sample (anonymized) doc bundle (<=200 cases) so we can pre-run the pack and finalize the SLOs.
- Security checklist: we will send the SOC2 evidence pack and a short network design document once we have a PoC scope.

Links & attachments (quick):
- Redwood perf CSV: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/DeepFit/pilot-benchmarks-20261021.csv
- Verified profiles PDF (attached): redwood-verified-profiles-202610.pdf
- Prompt pack (attached): deepfit-prompt-pack-v1.zip

I'll loop in Aditya (solutions) for the setup and Marissa for the pilot ops runbook below.

Thanks —
Soojin

- Can you confirm the SLA numbers for the dedicated pilot (uptime & p99 latency targets) if we move to Reserved/Committed capacity after pilot? Our security team also wants to see data retention and access controls (SOC2 artifacts).
- For the sample data ask: we can deliver a 150-case anonymized bundle by Friday (10/23). Should we FTP or is the Drive link fine?

Hi all — looping in the technical details you asked for. TL;DR answers below; details + links after.

1) SLA & pinning:
- Pilot: we offer a 99.5% pilot-level target (no formal SLA on pilot) with monitoring & alerting; for Reserved/Dedicated after pilot we can discuss an SLA (e.g., 99.9% uptime with operational on-call) as part of the reserved capacity contract.
- Model pinning: yes — we support pinning model versions per-route. We will not auto-upgrade pinned routes; rollouts are explicit.

2) Data retention & SOC2:
- SOC2 Type II report, network diagram, and our KMS integration notes are in the security pack (link below). We'll share the signed artifacts via secure Drive/SharePoint.

3) Cost ballpark for 2-worker Dedicated (US region):
- Estimated monthly: $21k–$30k depending on burst options and GPU type (lower end for Ampere 80GB shared configs; higher for reserved 4-worker plans). We will provide a tailored quote after we confirm expected qps and avg token length.

4) Benchmarks & trace links: full CSV with per-run traces and the Redwood-verified profile bundle: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/DeepFit/pilot-benchmarks-20261021.csv

5) Pilot plan & timeline:
- 10/26: pilot standup and credentials exchange
- 10/27–11/09: 2-week run (ops + regression checks)
- 11/10: debrief & recommendation

If you prefer, we can shorten to a 1-week smoke followed by a 1-week production-like run.

Notes: We measured TPS & latency with continuous-batch settings and a 2k seq warmup; if your typical doc lengths are heavier we will re-run with a small sample you send.

Links / artifacts:
- Security pack (SOC2 & network): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/DeepFit/security-pack-202610
- Pilot perf CSV: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/DeepFit/pilot-benchmarks-20261021.csv
- HubSpot (deal): https://hubspot.com/deals/DF-2026-9137
- DocuSign SOW (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPEID/ABC123DEF

Happy to jump on a 20-minute tech call with your infra folks tomorrow if helpful.

—Aditya
